mechanism.claim: An extreme completed five-minute ETH return relative to strictly prior ETH bipower variation, during a high-volatility BTC day, should lead BTC when BTC's simultaneous absolute return is at most half as large.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the completed ETH five-minute jump return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVEJCR is a sparse one-bar cross-asset lead-lag event with a muted simultaneous BTC response. HVEBCR used continuous six-hour beta residuals; HVELR/HVEDR used fixed eight-hour blocks and two-hour returns. No prior threshold, clock, control, artifact, or outcome is reused.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: BTC prior-day range must exceed frozen 2023H1 q60
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: rare ETH idiosyncratic jump times are not inputs to any Gross9 sleeve

features.sources: aligned exact BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT 5m OHLC aggregated from five 1m rows
features.returns: completed close-to-close five-minute log returns for each asset
features.eth_bipower_variation: pi/2 times sum of adjacent absolute ETH-return products over strictly prior 288 completed returns, excluding the current return
features.eth_jump_score: abs(current ETH return)/sqrt(prior ETH bipower variation/288)
features.btc_range_volatility: BTC high/low-1 over strictly prior 288 completed bars
features.calibration: 2023H1 BTC range q60 and ETH jump-score q99; no post-entry outcomes
features.onset: false-to-true ETH jump score>=q99 while BTC range>=q60 and muted BTC response; ETH return finite and nonzero

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium_implied_vol: not signal inputs; exact BTC funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first-failure sequence; no jump, response, side, hold, or gate repair
